name: sol_basics_vi_svi_11
description: Solidity 0.8.11–0.8.12 abi.encodeCall bug misencodes fixed-length bytes literal arguments
question: The source file in `source` declares pragma solidity version 0.8.11 or 0.8.12 and calls abi.encodeCall passing a fixed-length bytes literal (e.g. bytes4 or bytes32 literal) directly as one of the function arguments, rather than passing a variable, which triggers the compiler bug that incorrectly encodes such literals and corrupts the resulting calldata used for a low-level call.
